segments.name: Learning platform
segments.description: Chegg operates a learning platform offering skilling, language learning, and AI-driven academic support services to students, lifelong learners, and businesses.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, we have determined that we have a single operating and reportable segment and operating unit structure.

revenueModel.text: Chegg earns subscription revenues from students and lifelong learners for its learning services and from businesses for workforce skilling programs, plus advertising delivered with programmatic partners.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include learners and businesses.
